d.ko: Space Engineers 2 is a playable Early Access Alpha sandbox focused on engineering, exploration, and colonization in a fully destructible universe. Design and build ships, stations, and planetary bases while uncovering the story of Miro and Ivan Sokol. Help shape the future of the Almagest system.
d.en: Space Engineers 2 is a playable Early Access Alpha sandbox focused on engineering, exploration, and colonization in a fully destructible universe. Design and build ships, stations, and planetary bases while uncovering the story of Miro and Ivan Sokol. Help shape the future of the Almagest system.
d.zh: 《Space Engineers 2》是一款可游玩的抢先体验 Alpha 沙盒游戏，专注于在一个完全可破坏的宇宙中进行工程建造、探索与殖民。设计并建造飞船、空间站和行星基地，同时揭开 Miro 与 Ivan Sokol 的故事。帮助塑造 Almagest 星系的未来。
